clarity.notes: The Jogos page clearly separates discovery, search, category browsing, filters, featured shelves, and the full grid.

hierarchy.notes: The hero establishes the library, the controls sit directly below it, and large cards make game discovery the main focus.

typography.notes: The page reuses Playzenha display/body tokens, strong headline scale, tracked labels, and readable card metadata.

motion.notes: Cards use restrained hover lift/scale, with interaction feedback through favorites, rules modal, and toast states.

brand.notes: The page keeps #0441F2 and #FFC603 central while using secondary party colors for game identities.
